Principle 08 of 8

Responsibility

Workers, suppliers, communities, competitors, and the environment count too.

Protects

Workers, suppliers, communities, competitors, the environment

Why it matters

A business can be honest with every customer and still do harm to the people who make its products, the market it competes in, or the place it operates.

Covers

Worker and workplace conduct (Category 11), anti-competitive behavior (Category 12), supply chains (Category 13), and environmental conduct (Category 14).

Practices that break it
